sourceDescription: A one-person handmade craft studio making stickers, magnets, bookmarks, cups, tote bags, stationery, drink coozies, and home decor. No physical storefront. Kenzie sells directly to customers at local craft shows and markets across the tri-state area, alongside an active Instagram and Etsy shop. Brand voice is warm, personal, and genuinely enthusiastic: every product comes from one person's love of making things that make people smile.
